headline: How to Get Irisal
title: How to Get Irisal in Aniimo | Beat Alpha Irisal at Level 18 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Irisal is a Grass Aniimo that evolves from Iris. Find Iris in the Sea of Flowers, at levels nineteen to twenty eight. Raise it to level eighteen, then defeat the Alpha Irisal, because the evolution stays locked until you do. The Alpha is Grass, so bring Fire, Wind or Dark attackers and leave Grass ones at home. Do you run Irisal on your team? Comment below!
description: Irisal in Aniimo evolves from Iris at level 18 after you defeat the Alpha Irisal; use Fire, Wind or Dark attackers against it.
